title: Samiddhi’s Question About Suffering
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.67 Linked Discourses 35.67
  • 7. Migajālavagga 7. With Migajāla

Samiddhidukkhapañhāsutta Samiddhi’s Question About Suffering

“‘Dukkhaṁ, dukkhan’ti, bhante, vuccati. “Sir, they speak of this thing called ‘suffering’. Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dukkhaṁ vā assa dukkhapaññatti vā”ti …pe…. How do we define suffering or what is known as suffering?” …

Pañcamaṁ.
